rationale: POL-IAM-001 directly operationalizes NIST AC-7 by enforcing a hard 5-attempt limit on consecutive invalid logon attempts and a mandatory 15-minute lockout.
POL-IAM-001 satisfies ISO 27001:2022 Control A.8.5 by implementing secure authentication mechanisms and defense against automated credential stuffing.
POL-IAM-002 restricts superuser rights and requires individualized sudo elevation, directly implementing NIST AC-6 (Least Privilege).
POL-IAM-002 fulfills ISO 27001 Control A.8.2 by restricting and strictly managing privileged access rights across OS and database tiers.
POL-AUD-001 mandates logging of privilege elevations and authentication events, satisfying NIST AU-2 (Event Logging).
POL-AUD-001 directly satisfies ISO 27001 Control A.8.15 by requiring persistent generation, storage, and protection of security audit logs.
POL-DAT-001 mandates TLS encryption for all database connections, enforcing transmission confidentiality as required by NIST SC-8.
POL-DAT-001 enforces cryptographic controls on data in transit, fulfilling ISO 27001 Control A.8.24 (Use of Cryptography).
POL-DEV-001 enforces formal peer review and PR approvals before code enters production, operationalizing NIST CM-3 (Configuration Change Control).
POL-DEV-001 fulfills ISO 27001 Control A.8.32 by preventing unapproved direct changes to production codebases.
POL-AUP-001 defines acceptable use parameters for corporate devices, networks, and data, aligning with ISO 27001 Control A.5.10.
POL-AUP-001 establishes mandatory user rules of behavior and operational accountability required by NIST PL-4.
POL-AST-001 mandates continuous asset discovery, ownership assignment, and inventory reconciliation as required by ISO 27001 Control A.5.9.
POL-AST-001 requires maintaining an authoritative, automated component inventory matching NIST CM-8 requirements.
POL-CLS-001 establishes a formal four-tier classification schema fulfilling ISO 27001 Control A.5.12.
POL-CLS-001 defines data labelling and protective handling standards in accordance with ISO 27001 Control A.5.13.
POL-CLS-001 governs sensitivity classification and protective metadata attributes as outlined in NIST SC-16.
POL-CRY-001 mandates strong cryptographic cipher baselines and KMS key protection, satisfying ISO 27001 Control A.8.24.
POL-CRY-001 operationalizes key establishment, HSM storage, and annual rotation required by NIST SC-12.
POL-CRY-001 specifies approved cryptographic primitives and FIPS-validated modules required by NIST SC-13.
POL-VUL-001 mandates scheduled vulnerability discovery, severity-based SLAs, and patch validation in alignment with ISO 27001 Control A.8.8.
POL-VUL-001 enforces systematic identification and remediation of software flaws within 7/30 days as mandated by NIST SI-2.
POL-VUL-001 requires automated vulnerability scanning across all enterprise network ranges as specified in NIST RA-5.
POL-IRP-001 defines the organizational incident response structure and readiness procedures required by ISO 27001 Control A.5.24.
POL-IRP-001 establishes severity classification and triage criteria fulfilling ISO 27001 Control A.5.25.
POL-IRP-001 defines containment, eradication, and forensic recovery playbooks required by NIST IR-4.
POL-IRP-001 mandates 1-hour internal breach escalation and regulatory reporting timelines satisfying NIST IR-6.
POL-BCP-001 ensures continuity of information security controls during operational disruptions as required by ISO 27001 Control A.5.29.
POL-BCP-001 enforces multi-region failover and ICT readiness meeting ISO 27001 Control A.5.30.
POL-BCP-001 documents organizational contingency and disaster recovery plans required by NIST CP-2.
POL-BCP-002 mandates daily incremental snapshots, WORM storage, and restoration tests satisfying ISO 27001 Control A.8.13.
POL-BCP-002 operationalizes automated daily/weekly backup schedules and quarterly restore validation required by NIST CP-9.
POL-CHG-001 regulates formal change approval and rollback gating fulfilling ISO 27001 Control A.8.32.
POL-CHG-001 mandates documented CAB approval and audit logging of production changes as required by NIST CM-3.
POL-CFG-001 establishes standardized CIS hardening baselines and drift monitoring fulfilling ISO 27001 Control A.8.9.
POL-CFG-001 enforces mandatory secure configuration baselines across all OS and database tiers matching NIST CM-6.
POL-CFG-001 mandates disabling non-essential services, default credentials, and ports fulfilling NIST CM-7 (Least Functionality).
POL-NET-001 establishes boundary defenses, stateful firewall allow-lists, and segmentation meeting ISO 27001 Control A.8.20.
POL-NET-001 enforces perimeter protection, default-deny security groups, and traffic isolation required by NIST SC-7.
POL-TPM-001 establishes vendor due diligence and contractual security obligations fulfilling ISO 27001 Control A.5.19.
POL-TPM-001 addresses ICT supply chain security requirements in alignment with ISO 27001 Control A.5.21.
POL-TPM-001 mandates supply chain risk assessment and continuous monitoring matching NIST SR-3.
POL-RSK-001 incorporates threat intelligence into annual risk evaluations fulfilling ISO 27001 Control A.5.7.
POL-RSK-001 standardizes periodic enterprise risk assessment methodology satisfying NIST RA-3.
POL-TRN-001 mandates annual employee awareness and quarterly phishing simulations meeting ISO 27001 Control A.6.3.
POL-TRN-001 enforces mandatory literacy and cybersecurity awareness training for all users matching NIST AT-2.
POL-TRN-001 requires specialized secure coding and administrative training fulfilling NIST AT-3.
POL-PHY-001 mandates physical security perimeters and electronic badging satisfying ISO 27001 Control A.7.1.
POL-PHY-001 enforces 90-day CCTV monitoring and physical surveillance meeting ISO 27001 Control A.7.4.
POL-PHY-001 establishes physical access control points and visitor entry logs required by NIST PE-3.
POL-RET-001 governs timely and secure data deletion upon expiration of retention periods matching ISO 27001 Control A.8.10.
POL-RET-001 mandates certificates of destruction for decommissioned storage hardware satisfying ISO 27001 Control A.7.14.
POL-RET-001 specifies NIST SP 800-88 cryptographic wipe and physical degaussing sanitization required by NIST MP-6.
